articles.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
articles.description: The data center boom is running into serious real-world obstacles, from widespread local opposition and permitting delays to a scramble for electricity. Before those challenges even come into play, though, there’s a more basic problem: A lot of the projects being announced may never get built in the first place. With billions of dollars in AI infrastructure […]

articles.title: Meta is losing its longtime head of infrastructure
articles.description: Santosh Janardhan, who originally joined the company in 2009, will be stepping down from his role.

articles.title: Olaf Sakkers is betting he can beat the emerging-manager squeeze
articles.description: Entering into the world of venture capital has never been easy, especially as a first-time fund manager. But it's especially daunting right now. Olaf Sakkers has spent the past five years proving that difficult doesn't mean impossible.

articles.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
articles.description: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay upfront, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.

articles.title: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time

tech.summary:
今日科技动态摘要

1. AI芯片与算力竞争加剧：英国Fractile获7.2亿美元融资，加入AI芯片竞赛；CoreWeave转向客户预付款和缩短合同以资助AI增长。
2. OpenAI动态密集：季度营收首次突破100亿美元；收购Sonder创始人创办的旅游初创公司Odessia；纽约州AI安全法生效，OpenAI与Anthropic面临新监管。
3. 英伟达面临治理危机：美国国会将传唤黄仁勋就涉嫌中国间谍事件作证，公司治理专家密切关注，黄仁勋的个人行为也引发质疑。
4. Meta基础设施负责人长期任职后离职，数据中心建设不确定性增加。
5. X推出自有剪辑功能以促进网红互动，Databricks新AI agent以直言不讳的方式向CEO汇报。

今日最值得关注的是OpenAI季度营收首破百亿美元，显示AI商业化加速，同时纽约AI安全法生效标志着监管收紧。

ai.summary:
今日AI动态摘要

1. **端侧AI与语音技术突破**：Hugging Face发布BotPsy，一款基于十亿参数以下智能体语言模型的端侧个人助理；同时Phonon TTS推出高质量端侧语音合成，基准测试表现领先。
2. **Google Gemini多场景扩展**：Google推出Gemini Decisions API（快速、校准的多模态决策），Gemini Intelligence登陆更多设备，并将Gemini引入医疗健康领域（Google Cloud）。
3. **Hugging Face平台与模型生态更新**：支持用Google Cloud账户支付Hub费用；新增决策模型、多向量嵌入模型的Token Pooling感知训练，以及日本金融人口合成数据集Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan。
4. **语音识别与机器人学习**：埃及和尼日利亚英语加入Open ASR排行榜；ToyBlocks提供受控的机器人学习与评估环境。
5. **创意与协作工具**：Google Tabletop推出可定制的协作空间，Adobe创意与生产力工具进一步整合进Google应用。

今日最值得关注的是端侧AI的实用化提速——从BotPsy个人助理到Phonon TTS，小型化模型正直接落地到设备端。
